s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent fever with abdominal mass and liver involvement
salient_findings: Liver mass with abnormal perfusion and honeycomb enhancement
Staphylococcus aureus positive culture from liver lesion
key_facts: 11-month-old male child
Developed fever one week after measles vaccine
Fever initially resolved with Cefuroxime Axetil Granules
Fever recurred for about 10 days
Past medical history includes pneumonia, duodenal bulb ulcer, erosive gastritis, and Staphylococcus aureus septicemia and infective endocarditis
Initial WBC: 20.2×10^9/L
CRP: 146.4mg/L
Procalcitonin: 0.69ng/mL
ESR: 120mm/h
Blood film: rare neutrophils
Liver palpable 4 cm below rib margin
Tenderness on liver percussion
Abdominal CT showed patchy, slightly low-density shadow in segment IV of liver
Abdominal MRI showed mass shadow with mixed signal in SIV segment of liver
Heterozygous mutation in exon 3 of the ELANE gene
Liver tissue showed scattered hepatic structures with focal abscess changes

shortlist.label: ELANE-related neutropenia
shortlist.why_kept: Heterozygous mutation in exon 3 of the ELANE gene and history of recurrent fever

shortlist.label: Staphylococcal liver abscess
shortlist.why_kept: Liver tissue showed scattered hepatic structures with focal abscess changes and culture from liver lesion was positive for Staphylococcus aureus

shortlist.label: Congenital neutropenia
shortlist.why_kept: Rare neutrophils on blood film and recurrent fever

shortlist.label: Pyogenic liver abscess
shortlist.why_kept: Abdominal CT and MRI showed liver abscess and fever

shortlist.label: Severe congenital neutropenia
shortlist.why_kept: Recurrent fever, rare neutrophils, and history of severe infections

raw.rationale: The presence of a heterozygous mutation in exon 3 of the ELANE gene, which is associated with ELANE-related neutropenia, along with the child's history of recurrent infections and rare neutrophils on the blood film, supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Staphylococcal liver abscess
rejected.why: Although the liver tissue culture was positive for Staphylococcus aureus, this finding alone does not fully explain the child's underlying condition and recurrent infections.

rejected.label: Congenital neutropenia
rejected.why: This is a broader category that includes ELANE-related neutropenia, but the specific genetic mutation points more directly to ELANE-related neutropenia.

rejected.label: Pyogenic liver abscess
rejected.why: This diagnosis is too narrow, focusing only on the liver abscess without considering the child's broader history of infections and genetic findings.

rejected.label: Severe congenital neutropenia
rejected.why: While the child has neutropenia, the specific diagnosis of severe congenital neutropenia is not as directly supported by the genetic findings as ELANE-related neutropenia.
